title: 第3章 小红帽的外婆第4章 为什么总是这样的展开啊
lines: 格林跟着小红帽，很快来到了木屋门前，莫名的压力越来越大，仿佛门后有某个十分危险的存在。
“外婆，我是小红帽，我带吃的来看你了。”
小红帽说完后打开了门，小小的身体扛着裹着布的狼人尸体走了进去。
在门打开后，格林身体的危机感达到顶点，然后他无视了身体的预警，跟着小红帽径直走了进去。
推开吱呀作响的木门，暖金色的阳光透过彩绘玻璃窗洒进客厅，在褪色的亚麻地毯上投下斑驳的鸢尾花图案。
深棕色真皮沙发蜷在壁炉旁，扶手处磨得发亮，几个绣着玫瑰花纹的羊毛抱枕散落其间
窗台边锈迹斑斑的打字机盖着蕾丝刺绣布，针线筐里堆着钩针编织的半成品——似乎是一件毛衣？现在应该是夏天吧，就为入冬做准备了吗？
格林进入木屋后就在门口站着，他现在的行为应该类似于一种做客吧，那还是等见到对方之后再坐吧。
况且他现在就一件斗篷也不太好坐，站着反而遮得更严一点。
过了一会儿，爱丽丝带了一个老奶奶过来，穿着褪色的靛蓝围裙，戴着银手镯，看起来挺慈祥的老奶奶。
除了那股不知名的压力，不应该啊。
对方这种应该是那种隐居型的，应该给自己一种普通人的感觉啊，为什么自己一直觉得对方危险呢？
仔细想想，小红帽也会给他这种感觉。
只不过太轻微了，当时也就没注意，是因为对方有杀死自己的能力吗？估摸着要研究一下。
爱丽丝没有察觉格林有什么不对，跟身后的外婆继续聊着：
“外婆，这就是格林大哥哥，我在来的路上遇见的。
那个坏狼人就是他打败的，我看他没有衣服，就把他带过来了。
不然他会被爸爸他们抓起来的。”
外婆抬头看了一眼格林，然后低头跟小红帽笑着道：
“小红帽，你先回房间好不好，外婆跟大哥哥说些话。”
爱丽丝没有多问，乖乖地回到了房间里。
让格林不禁感叹：这么乖的孩子可不多见了。
外婆见小红帽走进了房间，将手中的衣服放到沙发上，问道：
“听小红帽讲，你在森林里迷路了？”
“是的，迷路了几天。
刚走出森林就碰到了那个狼人，然后遇到了爱丽丝，衣服问题是因为迷路的时候被食人花撕碎了，嗯——也许狼人也要承担一部分责任。”
“我知道了，你先在这里换一下衣服吧。
我和小红帽准备一下晚餐。”
“好的，麻烦你们了。
有什么需要帮忙的随时叫我。”
格林没有蹭吃蹭喝的习惯，自己能够出份力也好。
外婆则是再打量了一下格林之后笑道：“晚饭不用你准备，不过你可以去后院帮韩赛尔处理一下狼人。”
格林点了点头，他没有去问“韩赛尔”
是谁，毕竟等下接触一下就能推断出来。
以最快速度穿好衣服后，格林来到了后院，看到了一位少年：
看起来比爱丽丝年长好几岁，比自己低一个头，深棕色卷发随意地扎成低马尾，几缕碎发垂落在额前，穿着烟灰色粗布猎装，领口随意敞开露出结实的锁骨。
格林这才发现自己的衣服和对方是一样的，看来自己这套衣服原本是对方的。
“你好，我是来帮忙的。”
“格林，对吗？我是韩赛尔，爱丽丝的哥哥。
既然你来了，那就帮忙把这个狼人的皮扒下来吧。”
这种展开似乎有些怪异，可是格林不在意这点怪异，韩赛尔更不会多说什么了，两人均是在默默剥皮。
格林拿过一把小刀，指尖探入皮毛与血肉的缝隙，第一刀从喉管划向腹部，然后是腹腔，最后是尾根。
刀刃贴着肋骨游走，避开所有筋脉结节，沿关节处旋切，伴随着肌腱断裂的声声脆响，一张完整的狼皮被剥了下来。
content_en:
Green followed Little Red Riding Hood and soon came to the door of the wooden house. The inexplicable pressure was increasing, as if there was a very dangerous existence behind the door.
"Grandma, I'm Little Red Riding Hood, and I've come to see you with food."
After Little Red Riding Hood finished speaking, she opened the door and walked in with her little body carrying the werewolf corpse wrapped in cloth.
After the door opened, Green's sense of crisis reached its peak. Then he ignored his body's warning and followed Little Red Riding Hood straight in.
Pushing open the creaking wooden door, warm golden sunlight shines into the living room through the stained glass window, casting a mottled iris pattern on the faded linen carpet.
A dark brown leather sofa is curled up next to the fireplace, with polished armrests and several wool pillows embroidered with rose patterns scattered among them.
The rusty typewriter beside the windowsill is covered with lace embroidery cloth, and the sewing basket is piled with crocheted semi-finished products - it seems to be a sweater? It should be summer now, are you preparing for winter?
After Green entered the wooden house, he stood at the door. His current behavior should be similar to that of a guest, so it would be better to wait until he saw the other person before sitting down.
Besides, it's not easy for him to sit even with just a cloak, and it would cover him even more tightly when standing.
After a while, Alice brought an old woman over. She was wearing a faded indigo apron and a silver bracelet. She looked like a very kind old woman.
Except for that unknown pressure, it shouldn't be.
The other person should be a reclusive person, and should give me the feeling of an ordinary person. Why do I always feel that the other person is dangerous?
If you think about it, Little Red Riding Hood would give him this feeling too.
It was just too slight and I didn't notice it at the time. Was it because the other party had the ability to kill me? I guess I'll have to research it.
Alice didn't notice anything was wrong with Green and continued chatting with her grandmother behind her:
"Grandma, this is Brother Green, I met him on the way here.
He was the one who defeated the bad werewolf. I saw he had no clothes, so I brought him over.
Otherwise, he will be arrested by his father and others. "
Grandma looked up at Green, then lowered her head and smiled at Little Red Riding Hood:
"Little Red Riding Hood, could you please go back to your room first, and grandma has something to say to big brother."
"Okay."
Alice didn't ask any questions and returned to the room obediently.
Green couldn't help but sigh: It's rare to see such a well-behaved child.
Grandma saw Little Red Riding Hood enter the room, put the clothes in her hands on the sofa, and asked:
"Listen to Little Red Riding Hood, you were lost in the forest?"
“Yeah, got lost for a few days.
I met the werewolf as soon as I walked out of the forest, and then I met Alice. The problem with her clothes was because she was torn apart by piranha flowers when she was lost. Well - maybe the werewolf was also partly responsible. "
"I understand, please change your clothes here first.
Little Red Riding Hood and I are preparing dinner. "
"Okay, please.
If you need help with anything, call me anytime. "
Green doesn't have the habit of eating and drinking, so it's good that he can contribute.
Grandma looked at Green again and then said with a smile: "You don't need to prepare dinner, but you can go to the backyard to help Hansel deal with the werewolf."
Green nodded, he did not ask "Hansel"
Who it is, after all, you can deduce it after contacting him.
After getting dressed as quickly as possible, Green came to the backyard and saw a teenager:
She looks to be several years older than Alice, and a head lower than herself. Her dark brown curly hair is tied casually into a low ponytail, with a few strands of broken hair hanging down in front of her forehead. She is wearing a smoky gray coarse cloth hunting suit, with the collar casually open to reveal her strong collarbones.
Only then did Green realize that his clothes were the same as the other person's. It seemed that his clothes originally belonged to the other person.
"Hello, I'm here to help."
"Green, right? I'm Hansel, Alice's brother.
Now that you're here, help peel off this werewolf's skin. "
"Okay."
This development seemed a bit weird, but Green didn't care about this weirdness, and Hansel didn't say anything more. Both of them were peeling the skin silently.
Green took a small knife and inserted his fingertips into the gap between the fur and flesh. The first cut was from the throat to the abdomen, then the abdominal cavity, and finally the base of the tail.
The blade moved close to the ribs, avoiding all tendons and knots, and cut along the joints. With the crisp sound of tendons breaking, a complete wolf skin was peeled off.
title_en: Chapter 3 Little Red Riding Hood’s Grandma Chapter 4 Why does it always unfold like this?
